title: Kidney Bean Chaat
description: A delicious Indian-inspired chaat dish made with kidney beans, spices, and a hint of lemon. Perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cooked kidney beans, chaat masala, lemon juice, cilantro, onion, and tomato.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
